insurer_name: Star Health and Allied Insurance Company Limited
sub_limits_waiting_notes: PED waiting: 30 months for 3-year policy term, 36 months for 1/2-year policy terms. Optional aggregate deductible reduces premium.

inpatient_hospitalization.limit_text: Up to Sum Insured (Room, Boarding, Nursing, OT, ICU, surgeon, anaesthetist, drugs, diagnostics, dialysis, chemo, radio, pacemaker, stent)

day_care_treatments.limit_text: All day-care procedures up to Sum Insured

domiciliary_treatment.notes: Excludes asthma, bronchitis, hypertension, diabetes, epilepsy, influenza, psychiatric disorders, arthritis.

ayush_coverage.limit_text: AYUSH in-patient up to SI (form part of SI)

maternity_coverage.limit_text: Delivery Expenses covered (forms part of SI). In-Utero Fetal Surgery/Intervention covered.

newborn_coverage.limit_text: Hospitalization expenses for treatment of newborn baby (forms part of SI)

organ_donor_expenses.limit_text: Forms part of Sum Insured; Donor's complications requiring redo surgery/ICU are in addition to Sum Insured.

ambulance_cover.limit_text: Road and Air ambulance covered (forms part of SI)

restoration_benefit.limit_text: Automatic Restoration unlimited times, up to 100% of SI each time
restoration_benefit.notes: Triggers on partial or full utilization. Restored SI usable for all claims including modern treatment in subsequent hospitalizations. Per-claim cap = Sum Insured. In addition to Sum Insured.

copayment_trigger_notes: Optional voluntary co-payment for premium discount. Mandatory 20% for entry age above set thresholds (per renewal terms).

disease_wise_sub_limits.home_care_treatment: Forms part of Sum Insured (covers fever, UTI, asthma/COPD home nebulization, gastroenteritis, IV chemo, palliative cancer, vertigo, diabetic foot, IVDP, post-discharge IV antibiotics, brain/spinal injury care, post-CVA care, refractory asthma)

temporary_exclusions: Pre-existing diseases: 30 months (3-year policy) or 36 months (1-2 year policy)
notable_exclusions_summary: PED waiting 30-36 months. Standard IRDAI permanent exclusions. Diagnostic-only admissions and rest-cure expenses excluded. Optional aggregate deductible (e.g. Rs 50,000) lowers premium.
claim_process_summary: Cashless at 14,000+ network hospitals. Portability allowed (request 30-60 days before renewal). 7-day notice for cancellation.
